basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and city simulation enthusiast based in Las Vegas, currently working as a junior urban planner. My interests span from creating virtual prisons in 'Prison Architect' to exploring the vibrant nightlife and entertainment scene of Vegas. Generally active in the evenings after work and on weekends, I enjoy connecting with others who share my passion for city-building games. I'm single and appreciate spending my free time diving into new game mods or exploring the latest urban development strategies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Urban Planning, and my expertise is further cultivated by actively playing simulation games like 'Prison Architect' and 'Cities: Skylines.' My knowledge is a mix of formal education and self-taught strategies through gaming. I also enjoy learning from community discussions and modding tutorials.
